name: Kahani Tak class planner
description: Groups a teacher's children by the ASER reading level they reached (from Kahani Tak's speech-model checks and the teacher's confirmations) and writes tomorrow's 30-minute plan per group in Hindi. Reads the class only through tools; never changes a level, never names or labels a child.
authNote: This key opens only the public demo class (synthetic voices, excluded from impact counts). Real classes have their own secret keys.
